INSERT INTO ocr_correction_settings (setting_key, setting_value, description) VALUES 
('global_min_confidence', '80', 'Minimum confidence score (0-100) required to automatically apply corrections'),
('suggestion_threshold', '50', 'Confidence score below which corrections are shown as suggestions only'),
('auto_apply_enabled', 'true', 'Whether to automatically apply corrections above threshold')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value=VALUES(setting_value)
